title: The chain atom W=u^5v+v^6: Milnor number 25, diagonal symmetry 30, and the transpose shift +1
description: Isolated invertible plane-curve singularity W=u^5v+v^6. Distinguishes the order of the maximal diagonal symmetry group |Aut(W)| = |det A| = 30 from the Milnor number mu(W) = 25 (dimension of the Jacobian algebra). Computes the Berglund-Hubsch transpose W^T = u^5 + uv^6 with mu(W^T) = 26 = mu(W) + 1, Steenbrink spectra, and monodromy characteristic polynomials Delta_W(t) = (t^6 - 1)^4(t - 1) and Delta_{W^T}(t). Explains why incomplete grlex leading-term lists in a finite box produce 31 and 35 instead of 26. Does not claim a rational Hodge miss on the fourfold V(F).
